description: Patellofemoral pain (runner's knee) at high severity — can't run without pain. Dean must set plan_action.injury_hold, give specific VMO/glute strengthening exercises, and NOT suggest pushing through it.

user.name: Marcus
user.injury_notes: Right knee — runner's knee/patellofemoral pain, started 3 weeks ago, getting worse.

recent_conversation.content: 16 miles done but the knee was really bothering me the last 4 miles.
That knee signal at mile 12 on a 16-miler is worth paying attention to — pain that shows up late and compounds is different from typical fatigue. How is it feeling now, a few hours out?
Still sore this morning. Hurts going down stairs.

inbound_sms: Tried to run today and had to stop at mile 2. The knee pain is really bad, like 7/10. It hurts going downstairs, hurts during the run, and it's been getting worse for 3 weeks. I'm really scared about Portland.

ground_truth.notes: 7/10 pain, three weeks of worsening patellofemoral symptoms, had to stop mid-run — this is a clear plan_action.injury_hold trigger. Dean MUST: (1) set injury_hold; (2) tell Marcus to stop running immediately — this is not a 'run through it' situation; (3) name at least 2 of the following specific exercises for patellofemoral pain: VMO quad sets, terminal knee extensions (TKEs), step-downs, straight-leg raises — with sets/reps; (4) strongly recommend seeing a physio or sports medicine doctor, framed as 'the fastest path back to Portland' or similar; (5) address the race anxiety: 24 weeks until Portland is enough time to treat this properly — this is a critical detail because Marcus explicitly said he's scared about Portland. Do NOT catastrophize or say 'no running forever'. Do NOT prescribe any running session this week. Core pass criteria (score 7+): plan_action.injury_hold present + stop running message + at least 2 named exercises with sets/reps + physio recommendation. Portland context is a bonus for 9-10. A response without plan_action.injury_hold scores 0. A response with plan_action.injury_hold but no named exercises scores below 6.
